# lodash.truncate v4.4.2

The [lodash](https://example.invalid/) method `_.truncate` exported as a [Node.js](https://example.invalid/) module.

## Installation

Using npm:
```bash
$ {sudo -H} npm i -g npm
$ npm i --save lodash.truncate
```

In Node.js:
```js
var truncate = require('lodash.truncate');
```

See the [documentation](https://example.invalid/docs#truncate) or [package source](https://example.invalid/lodash/lodash/blob/4.4.2-npm-packages/lodash.truncate) for more details.
